units.systemd-root:
[Unit]
Description=WebClash (mihomo web panel)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/webclash run
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/webclash/webclash.env
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/webclash
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3s
KillMode=mixed
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStartSec=90
TimeoutStopSec=30
LimitNOFILE=65535
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_NET_RAW CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_NET_RAW CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
DeviceAllow=/dev/net/tun rw
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=false
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/webclash
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

init.systemd-root:
#!/sbin/openrc-run
# WebClash service (generated by webclash install)

command="${WEBCLASH_BIN:-/usr/local/bin/webclash}"
command_args="run"
command_background=true
command_user="${WEBCLASH_USER:-root}"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
directory="${WEBCLASH_DATA_DIR:-/var/lib/webclash}"
output_log="${WEBCLASH_LOG:-/var/log/webclash.log}"
error_log="${WEBCLASH_LOG:-/var/log/webclash.log}"

export DATA_DIR="${WEBCLASH_DATA_DIR:-/var/lib/webclash}"
export WEBUI_PORT="${WEBCLASH_PORT:-7788}"
export WEBUI_HOST="${WEBCLASH_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"
export NODE_ENV="production"

depend() {
    use net dns logger
    after firewall
}

start_pre() {
    checkpath -d -m 0750 -o "${WEBCLASH_USER:-root}:${WEBCLASH_USER:-root}" "${WEBCLASH_DATA_DIR:-/var/lib/webclash}"
    checkpath -f -m 0640 -o "${WEBCLASH_USER:-root}:${WEBCLASH_USER:-root}" "${WEBCLASH_LOG:-/var/log/webclash.log}"
    if [ ! -e /dev/net/tun ]; then
        ewarn "未检测到 /dev/net/tun，TUN 模式不可用"
    fi
}

WEBUI_PORT=7788
